set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- PRs run R CMD check on Linux, macOS, and Windows.
- At least one job installs all Suggests needed for advertised solvers.
- Tests, examples, vignettes, compiled code, and docs fail the workflow when broken.
- Artifacts retain check logs and test summaries.
- Package-check protection is independent of performance gates.
set.title: Add cross-platform R CMD check and full test CI
